# Arkansas Automated

> Arkansas Automated runs in-person AI workshops and done-for-you automation builds for Arkansas small businesses. Public workshop seats run Saturday afternoons in Fort Smith ($497 early bird). Done-for-you services include a 24/7 AI front desk ($2,500 setup + $497/mo), a fixed-price AI operations audit ($999), workflow automation builds ($1,500-$5,000 setup), and an embedded on-site retainer (from $2,000/mo). Workshop and audit fees credit toward any build started within 60 days. Based in Fort Smith, serving all of Arkansas.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://arkansasautomated.com/): workshops, done-for-you services, FAQ, and the reservation form
- [Services and pricing](https://arkansasautomated.com/services): all engagement types with public pricing
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://arkansasautomated.com/pricing.md): structured price sheet for AI agents
- [AI workshops by city](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-workshops): 16 Arkansas cities with local details
- [Automation by industry](https://arkansasautomated.com/for): plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, dentists, law firms, real estate, clinics, auto repair, landscapers
- [Guides](https://arkansasautomated.com/learn): plain-language answers on AI receptionists, costs, and automation
